digest: isWorkflowStopRequestedError accepts message-prefix matches, violating S6's name-only rule; real but latent because no src caller exists.

evidence.relevance: Classifier is the function under review; its body spans lines 53-59
Message-prefix branch that S6 forbids as a classification basis

counterEvidence.relevance: In-repo creator always sets the name, so the message branch matters only for foreign errors with the same prefix; this narrows impact but does not remove the spec violation
No src caller of isWorkflowStopRequestedError was found, so no current behavior depends on the message branch

finalClaim: isWorkflowStopRequestedError (src/workflow-stop.ts:53-59) also classifies any Error whose message starts with 'workflow stop requested' as a stop error, contrary to SPEC S6 (name-only, no message-based classification). No test covers the classifier. Impact is latent: no src caller exists and in-repo errors always carry the name.
recommendedAction: Remove the message-prefix disjunct so the function checks only error.name === WORKFLOW_STOP_REQUESTED_ERROR_NAME, and add a test that a plain Error with the matching message returns false and a WorkflowStopRequested-named error returns true.
